description: Figure 7 illustrates the accuracy of Llama3.3 on PopQA with respect to s_pop and o_pop. The x-axis is labeled "s_pop frequency (x10^4)" and uses a linear scale ranging from 1 to 19, with tick marks at regular intervals of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Accuracy" and uses a linear scale ranging from 0.0 to 1.0, with tick marks at intervals of 0.2. The plot contains two lines, both featuring vertical error bars at each data point. A blue dashed line with circular markers begins at x=1 with a value of approximately 0.8, rises to roughly 0.95 at x=3, and remains relatively stable across the rest of the axis, with a minor dip to about 0.85 at x=13 before ending at x=19 near 0.95. A green solid line with plus markers starts lower at x=1 with a value of approximately 0.4. It fluctuates significantly, showing peaks at x=5 (~0.65), x=9 (~0.7), and x=13 (~0.65), and dips at x=7 (~0.5), x=11 (~0.5), and x=15 (~0.55), before sharply rising to align with the blue line at approximately 0.95 for x=17 and x=19.
